# Title

Qualified name: `manim.mobject.text.tex\_mobject.Title`

class Title(*\*text\_parts*, *include\_underline=True*, *match\_underline\_width\_to\_text=False*, *underline\_buff=0.25*, *\*\*kwargs*)
:   Bases: [`Tex`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.text.tex_mobject.Tex.html#manim.mobject.text.tex_mobject.Tex "manim.mobject.text.tex_mobject.Tex")

    A mobject representing an underlined title.

    Examples

    Example: TitleExample

    ![../_images/TitleExample-1.png](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/_images/TitleExample-1.png)

    ```
    from manim import *

    import manim

    class TitleExample(Scene):
        def construct(self):
            banner = ManimBanner()
            title = Title(f"Manim version {manim.__version__}")
            self.add(banner, title)
    ```
